description: Actions permissions: a pattern added by hand to the allowed actions, and the workflow token allowed to approve
source: github/rest-api-description@02e8fa6 response examples: GET .../actions/permissions; GET .../actions/permissions/selected-actions; GET .../actions/permissions/workflow
declaration:
actions:
  enabled: true
  allowed_actions: selected
  sha_pinning_required: true
  selected_actions:
    github_owned_allowed: true
    verified_allowed: false
    patterns_allowed: [docker/*]
  workflow:
    default_workflow_permissions: read
    can_approve_pull_request_reviews: false
